storage_root.label: Storage root (absolute path inside the toolbox; exactly ONE toolbox instance may use a given store — a second instance sharing it is unsupported and needs a real distributed lock)

published_root.label: Published tree root (absolute path inside the toolbox; the artifacts server reads it read-only)

serving/keep_versions.label: Materialized version previews to keep per artifact (0 keeps every version; the current one is never pruned)

serving/public_base_url.label: Public base URL of the artifacts server, used to build the preview link

allowed_artifacts.label: Artifacts this scope may use (comma-separated artifact codes; empty denies everything)

limits/max_diff_bytes.label: Max diff bytes returned to the agent

security/allow_symlinks.label: Allow symbolic links (only false is supported)
